name: Beach and shore
about: Sand, shingle and mud-flat edges above the tide: palms, driftwood, rock. Density: KoTM palms 24/ha within 10 m of water.

name: Cliff face
about: Slopes of 28 deg and more: cliff pieces with their open back uphill. Density: vanilla cliffs 5.7 to 12.5/ha.

name: Coastal grassland
about: Open grass behind the shore, salt-tolerant shrubs, scattered trees. Density: KoTM LALPAMarshGrass 39/ha.

name: Cypress swamp
about: Bald cypress over black water and mud with knees, moss and ferns. Density: KoTM LALPAMud01 148/ha.

name: Drowned forest
about: Forest standing in permanent still water, 0.3 to 3 m deep (hard cap 3.5 m). Density: BM2 flooded trees 60/ha plus shrubs and reeds.

name: Dry hammock
about: Raised firm ground, mounds and island interiors: palms, erut and bottle trees, scrub. Density: between KoTM rainforest (130) and marsh grass (39).

name: Hist grove
about: Root-hummocks round the great Hist trees, deep moss and fungus.

name: Lake and river-mouth bed
about: Fresh or brackish still bed below the surface: kelp, weed, clams. Density: Depths median 3 refs per 0.34 ha cell.

name: Mangrove fringe
about: Tidal mud and shallow brackish water at the coast and estuary edge. Density: BM1/BM2 mangrove and reed refs in flooded nodes.

name: Open still water
about: Ponds, pools and slow backwaters: lily patches and water weed only. Density: KoTM LALPARiverBottom01 27/ha.

name: Rainforest floor
about: Closed jungle on firm ground: emergent hardwoods, mid-canopy, undergrowth, ferns, fungus. Density: KoTM LALPARainforestNG 130/ha.

name: Reed marsh
about: Reed and cattail beds in shallow still water and wet mud. Density: BM1 reeds 194/ha flooded; most of a marsh is groundcover grass, so the object layer is lighter.

name: Riverine forest
about: Gallery forest on banks and levees beside rivers; never in the flowing water. Density: KoTM trees 60/ha within 10 m of water plus understorey.

name: Rocky outcrop
about: Rock outcrops, crags and the foot of cliffs: boulders clumped (KoTM R 0.52) and the cliff-foot pile layer (study rec. 4). Density: vanilla boulders 20 to 38/ha.

name: Seabed, deep (20 to 80 m)
about: Tall seaweed forests, clams and rock on the deep floor. Depths bands 20-40 m 1,093 and 40-80 m 831 refs.

name: Seabed, mid (5 to 20 m)
about: Kelp, moss rocks and clams. Depths bands 5-10 m 367 and 10-20 m 857 refs.

name: Seabed, shallow (0 to 5 m)
about: Coral and kelp shallows. Depths depth band 2-5 m holds 983 of 4,238 refs.

name: Swamp hummock
about: Firm wet ground between channels: dense shrub, tree, fern. Density: BM2 LPineForest03 (the swamp ground) 198/ha.

name: Upland scrub
about: Ridge and mesa tops: tall grass, thorn scrub, stunted trees, rock. Density: BM2 LFieldGrass02 56/ha.
